video_title: ISS Crew-11 Pilot Hands Over Control
topic: iss astronaut medical evacuation latest news: crew-11 pilot to hand control of station over today

text: Breaking news is coming in from space about a medical emergency on the International Space Station
A Crew-11 pilot is set to hand over control of the station in a matter of hours
NASA has announced that the pilot will officially hand over control today as part of a planned medical evacuation procedure
The medical condition is non-life-threatening but requires immediate attention on Earth
The International Space Station has been continuously occupied by astronauts since 2000
Medical emergencies are rare on the space station, but NASA has protocols in place for emergency situations
The identity of the affected astronaut has not been officially disclosed by NASA
The medical condition is not related to any spacewalk or scientific experiment
The rest of the crew is reported to be in good health
The situation continues to unfold with uncertainty about the long-term implications
The medical evacuation may have implications for the Crew-11 mission
And the overall operations of the International Space Station
NASA officials are expected to provide further updates in the coming days
As the situation develops, more information will become available
